objective: sum measured_band_power * supplied_ear_gain * band_average_T / sum measured_band_power * supplied_ear_gain
within_band_assumption: Uniform power per Hz; contiguous edges are geometric midpoints of adjacent rounded nominal centres, endpoint ratios 2^(1/6). Ear gain held at supplied band value.
angles: Optimised for normal incidence only. No assumed directional energy weights.
limitations: Rigid lossless 2D periodic model; no screens, finite-wall effects, supports or thermoviscous loss
All nonzero supplied bands included; 20 kHz band is zero input power and contributes zero without solving
Limited local optimisation, not global optimum
Band quadrature convergence and spatial resolution are finite; narrow resonances may remain unresolved
75% opening leaves no extra blockage allowance for supports
integration_label: 17 points per band; 800, 1000 and 1250 Hz bands refined to 33–65 points
